steps.name: Compile and execute exact registry controls
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(rustc --version)" = 'rustc 1.97.1 (8bab26f4f 2026-07-14)'
rustc --edition=2024 --test sdk/rust-standard-runtime/tests/thread_registry_native.rs -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-thread-registry-source"
"$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-thread-registry-source" --list | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-thread-registry-list.txt"
python3 - "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-thread-registry-list.txt" <<'PY'
import pathlib, sys
lines = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text().splitlines()
actual = [line.removesuffix(': test') for line in lines if line.endswith(': test')]
expected = {
    'finite_reservations_cannot_reuse_a_stale_handle_or_rollback_accepted_work',
    'admission_refuses_root_alias_and_duplicate_or_malformed_real_identities',
    'actual_entry_identity_and_threadinit_tls_and_reap_boundaries_are_ordered',
    'joining_requires_reap_and_exact_claim_before_packet_can_be_consumed',
    'real_join_dependencies_refuse_self_cycles_and_tls_exit_with_unfinished_join',
    'detach_keeps_real_child_and_original_owner_until_tls_frames_and_canonical_reap',
    'runnable_snapshot_owns_no_borrow_and_does_not_equal_completion_or_empty_registry',
    'physical_reaper_claim_remains_exclusive_until_actual_free_and_settlement_return',
    'final_root_close_removes_only_reaped_tombstones_after_all_user_frames',
    'reaped_unjoined_child_does_not_reserve_recycled_canonical_or_context_identity',
    'reaping_keeps_old_join_pending_while_freed_context_and_index_are_reused',
    'finished_unjoined_child_keeps_join_identity_while_its_canonical_slot_is_reused',
    'cycle_detection_still_follows_live_handles_after_old_index_is_reused',
    'canonical_reuse_refuses_admitted_ready_and_running_children',
}
assert len(actual) == len(set(actual)) == len(expected) == 14 and set(actual) == expected
PY
"$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-thread-registry-source" --test-threads=1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-thread-registry-result.txt"
grep -Eq '^test result: ok[.] 14 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;' "$RUNNER_TEMP/rust-thread-registry-result.txt"

steps.name: Compile and execute exact pool worker identity controls
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
for suite in executor_lifecycle_native executor_worker_native executor_control_native executor_root_native; do
  timeout 60s rustc --edition=2024 --test "sdk/rust-standard-runtime/tests/$suite.rs" -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/$suite"
done
python3 - "$RUNNER_TEMP" <<'PY'
import pathlib, re, subprocess, sys
root = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
expected = {'executor_lifecycle_native': ['actual_worker_start_and_complete_provision_are_required_before_acceptance', 'closing_worker_tls_submission_requires_actual_successor_and_old_close_cannot_kill_it', 'fallible_admission_reservation_pins_worker_without_accepting_or_losing_work', 'finite_close_round_limit_refuses_before_an_unclosable_successor_or_future_is_accepted', 'independent_pool_state_and_empty_queue_do_not_confuse_unfinished_future', 'logical_empty_still_waits_for_real_wake_drop_tls_and_frame_boundaries', 'partially_started_generation_retains_started_worker_until_its_real_exit', 'successor_reuses_index_only_after_old_worker_tls_drains_without_retiring_its_record', 'wake_requeue_is_reserved_before_admission_and_late_generation_never_recreates_task'], 'executor_worker_native': ['recycled_canonical_index_retains_distinct_worker_keys_and_arc_leases', 'worker_lease_frame_callback_keeps_each_real_child_identity_after_return_to_root', 'worker_lease_refuses_root_ready_foreign_context_stale_executor_and_duplicate_transfer', 'worker_lease_retains_actual_arc_until_separate_tls_and_frame_notifications'], 'executor_control_native': ['actual_bridge_carries_worker_keys_through_recycled_canonical_index_and_arc_release', 'old_and_new_worker_callbacks_are_keyed_to_their_own_generations', 'three_reused_generations_retire_only_their_exact_worker_keys'], 'executor_root_native': ['captured_pool_and_control_retire_before_executor_completion_notification', 'last_executor_retirement_notifies_the_second_drain_check', 'pending_executor_keeps_its_owner_and_does_not_invent_a_notification', 'release_callback_successor_requires_a_fresh_scan_and_keeps_its_owner', 'retirement_invalidates_a_previously_quiescent_stamp']}
for suite, cases in expected.items():
    listing = subprocess.run([str(root / suite), "--list"], capture_output=True, timeout=60, check=True)
    assert len(listing.stdout) <= 1024 * 1024 and len(listing.stderr) <= 1024 * 1024
    observed = [line.removesuffix(": test") for line in listing.stdout.decode().splitlines() if line.endswith(": test")]
    assert len(observed) == len(set(observed)) == len(cases) and set(observed) == set(cases), suite
    result = subprocess.run([str(root / suite), "--test-threads=1"], capture_output=True, timeout=60, check=True)
    assert len(result.stdout) <= 1024 * 1024 and len(result.stderr) <= 1024 * 1024
    passed = re.findall(rb"^test ([^\r\n]+) \.\.\. ok$", result.stdout, re.M)
    assert len(passed) == len(cases) and {name.decode() for name in passed} == set(cases), suite
    assert f"test result: ok. {len(cases)} passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored;".encode() in result.stdout, suite
    print(result.stdout.decode(), end="")
PY
